description: Police Commission - National Police Commission Amended Extra Gazette No . 2341/51 on 20.07.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the National Police Commission amending its delegation of powers in accordance with constitutional provisions (Article 155J). It modifies regulatory frameworks for police officer transfers, interdictions, and disciplinary control, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory procedures governing law enforcement operations.
